sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Something's off! The object is now at (20,9)?? O rows 20-21, b rows 22-24, cols 9-13. Expected: LEFT×3 from (10,24) → (10,14), then DOWN×5 → (20,14). But actually: (20,9)??
Wait: LEFT×3 from (10,24): (10,19), (10,14), (10,9). Ohh! I made a calculation mistake earlier: from (10,24), LEFT×3 → (10,24-5*3=9) = (10,9). I was thinking the object was at (10,24) and needed LEFT×3 to reach (10,14) — but 24-15=9, not 14! To go from (10,24) to (10,14) you only need LEFT×2. I over-moved by one.
So the object is at (10,9), then DOWN×5 → (20,9). Currently (20,9): rows 20-24, cols 9-13.
Now, the left corridor is cols 14-18. The object at (20,9) has its window at cols 9-13 — one step to the left of the corridor. To the left of the corridor (cols 9-13) at rows 20-24: is it G? From the map: rows 20-24, cols 9-20 are G (left region). So (20,9) is inside the left region, not in the corridor.
To dock, I need to get to (35,14). From (20,9): RIGHT → (20,14) (window rows 20-24, cols 14-18: G ✓). Then DOWN×5 → (35,14). Then DOWN → (40,14) to dock.
So: RIGHT, DOWN×6. Total 7 moves.
Check: (20,14) → DOWN: (25,14) rows 25-29 cols 14-18 G ✓; (30,14) ✓; (35,14) rows 35-39 cols 14-18: G+B ✓; (40,14) dock.
But wait — P1 (yellow square) is at rows 16-18, cols 15-17 — the object's window at (15,14) would cover it, but we're now at (20,9) so we skip (15,14). No problem.
Execute RIGHT + DOWN×6 (7 moves).
